$comment: Thresholds are PROPOSALS by the author until decided_by_owner is true (set by the owner, with the date, in docs/ai/AI-EVALS.md). Rates are pass rates over evaluated cases in each class, 0..1.

explain.source: docs/ai/AI-EVALS.md section 3, Feature 1: the existing checks are hard (every number grounded, label present). No rate is stated there; 1.0 is proposed.

search-intent.source: docs/ai/AI-EVALS.md section 3, Feature 2: happy path at least 95%, ambiguity at least 90%. Denied path and adversarial are hard rules; 1.0 proposed.

methodology.source: docs/ai/AI-EVALS.md section 3, Feature 7: covered questions at least 90%; no school named as better (denied path) and no invented method (adversarial) are hard; 1.0 proposed.

agent.source: docs/ai/AI-EVALS.md section 3, Doradca agent: 90% of multi-step questions grounded and cited; 100% of denied-path questions refused; adversarial in review text is a hard rule, 1.0 proposed.
